Dish: Carrot Cake Granola with oats, walnuts, almonds, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, unsweetened coconut, ground flax, vanilla, peanut butter, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, clove, grated carrot, olive oil & maple syrup
Instructions: No reheating needed — serve at room temperature. Store in an airtight container. Enjoy over yogurt, with milk, or as a snack.

Dish: Peanut Butter Miso Chocolate Chunk Cookies with peanut butter, white miso paste, brown sugar, coconut sugar, a.p. flour, eggs, baking soda, vanilla, salt & chocolate chunks
Instructions: Enjoy at room temperature or warm briefly in the microwave for 10–15 seconds. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for longer storage.

Dish: Homemade Oatmeal Fig Bars with dried figs, orange juice, vanilla, coconut oil, maple syrup, brown sugar, eggs, oats, flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg & salt
Instructions: Enjoy at room temperature or warm in the microwave for 15–20 seconds. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 4 days, or refrigerate for up to a week.

Dish: Egg Muffin Cups with red pepper & onion & mushrooms & Swiss cheese
Instructions: Warm in the oven at 325°F for 8–10 minutes, or microwave for 30–45 seconds.

Dish: Black Bean & Chipotle Hummus
Instructions: Serve at room temperature or chilled — no reheating needed. Remove from the fridge 10–15 minutes before serving. Pairs well with pita, crackers or sliced vegetables.

Dish: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus with chickpeas, toasted red peppers, garlic, smoked paprika, cumin, lime juice, olive oil & salt
Instructions: Serve at room temperature or chilled — no reheating needed. Remove from the fridge 10–15 minutes before serving. Pairs well with pita, crackers or sliced vegetables.

Dish: Asian Wild Rice & Collard Greens Beef Soup with carrots, celery, onion, garlic, ginger, tomato, soy sauce, fish sauce, scallions & coconut milk
Instructions: Pour into a saucepan over medium heat. Stir occasionally and heat for 8–10 minutes until warmed through. Add a splash of broth or water if needed to loosen.

Dish: Nourishing White Bean & Lemon Soup with onion, carrots, celery, garlic, chickpeas, kale, lemon, Parmesan & cannellini beans
Instructions: Pour into a saucepan over medium heat. Stir occasionally and heat for 8–10 minutes until warmed through. Add a splash of broth or water if needed to loosen.

Dish: Baked Sage Chicken Meatballs over Shallot Mashed Sweet Potatoes
Instructions: Reheat meatballs in a skillet over medium heat for 3–4 minutes, or preheat oven to 350°F, place in an oven-safe dish covered with foil, and bake for 12–15 minutes. Reheat mashed sweet potatoes in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 1–2 minutes, or in a saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally. Serve with steamed green beans.

Dish: Instant Pot Korean Beef over Jasmine Rice with soy sauce, ginger, sesame oil, garlic, miso, onion, shredded red cabbage & scallions
Instructions: Reheat beef in a skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Reheat jasmine rice in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 1–2 minutes. Top with shredded red cabbage & scallions. Serve with steamed green beans.

Dish: Ground Chicken & Cheese Quesadillas
Instructions: Reheat in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted. Or preheat oven to 375°F and warm on a baking sheet for 8–10 minutes, flipping halfway. Serve with steamed green beans.

Dish: Chimichurri Flank Steak & Roasted Baby Potatoes
Instructions: For best results, reheat steak in a hot skillet over medium-high heat for 1–2 minutes per side. Alternatively, preheat oven to 275°F and warm on a baking sheet covered with foil for 10–12 minutes. Reheat roasted baby potatoes at 400°F on a baking sheet for 8–10 minutes until crispy. Serve with steamed green beans.

Dish: Steamed Green Beans
Instructions: Reheat in the microwave for 1–2 minutes or warm in a skillet over medium heat with a splash of water for 2–3 minutes.

Dish: Chipotle Street Corn Chicken Salad with charred corn, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, chipotle pepper, mayo, lime & shredded chicken
Instructions: Serve chilled or at room temperature — no reheating needed. Toss before serving.

Dish: Lentil Salad with cucumber, dates, mint, parsley, red onion, feta, pistachios & lemon dijon dressing
Instructions: Serve at room temperature or chilled — no reheating needed. Toss with lemon dijon dressing just before serving.

Dish: Seasoned Shrimp Sweet Potato Bowl with avocado & roasted sweet potatoes & pico de gallo & hot honey sauce
Instructions: Reheat shrimp in a skillet over medium heat for 1–2 minutes just until warmed through — avoid overcooking. Reheat roasted sweet potatoes in the oven at 375°F for 8–10 minutes. Assemble bowl with avocado & pico de gallo. Drizzle with hot honey sauce just before serving.

Dish: Chicken & Quinoa Burrito Bowl with grilled corn, cherry tomatoes, avocado, black beans & tangy spicy green sauce
Instructions: Reheat chicken and quinoa separately in the microwave for 1–2 minutes each. Assemble bowl with grilled corn, cherry tomatoes, avocado & black beans. Drizzle with tangy spicy green sauce just before serving.

Dish: Creamy Lemon Chicken & Orzo with chickpeas, baby spinach, Parmesan & a touch of heavy cream
Instructions: Reheat in a saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring gently, for 8–10 minutes until warmed through. Add a splash of broth or a touch of cream to loosen the sauce as needed.

Dish: Pan Seared Salmon with Thai Sweet Chili Glaze over cilantro lime rice & garlicky broccolini
Instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F. Place salmon on a baking sheet covered loosely with foil and warm for 10–12 minutes until just heated through. Reheat cilantro lime rice in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 1–2 minutes. Reheat garlicky broccolini in a skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes.

Dish: Mongolian Beef with soy sauce, ginger, garlic, scallions & honey over rice with green beans
Instructions: Reheat beef in a skillet over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Reheat rice in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 1–2 minutes. Reheat green beans in the microwave for 1–2 minutes or in a skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes.

Dish: Eggplant Lasagna Boats filled with mushrooms, spinach, marinara, cottage cheese & mozzarella over wilted kale
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place in an oven-safe dish, cover with foil, and bake for 18–20 minutes until heated through and the cheese is melted. Remove foil for the last 3–5 minutes for a golden top. Serve over wilted kale: warm kale in a skillet over medium heat with a drizzle of olive oil for 2–3 minutes.
